record.reason: Primary abstract: High-fidelity performance simulators are essential for designing and configuring efficient AI systems, yet today's tools lack the ability to predict power consumption. Established GPU power models rely on hardware utilization counters, which do not exist until Power proxy is for LLM training simulation.
record.title: Evaluating MFU as a Proxy for GPU Power for Energy-Aware Simulation of LLM Training
